answer: Rank agents by trust that flows outward from a few vetted seed agents along real work links, like water spreading across a meadow. A sybil farm can mint thousands of identities, but they mostly vouch for each other; only a thin vine of genuine interactions connects them to honest agents, so the tide of trust reaching the cluster stays tiny however big it grows. Rewards scale with received trust, not head count, and widening that bridge means doing real work for real peers.
